title: Seema Raja
desc: Seema Raja, the generous and carefree prince of Singampatti, becomes a responsible king and the saviour of his people after his grand-uncle reveals to him the history of his heroic heritage.

title: Gaddalakonda Ganesh
desc: A film-maker aspires to make a gangster movie and selects the hardened Gaddalakonda Ganesh as his subject. Soon, he and his friend put their lives on the line to follow Gaddalakonda's life.

title: Detective
desc: A brilliant detective investigating the murder of a dog unearths a far more sinister crime that he stumbles upon by accident.

title: Magadheera
desc: A kind-hearted young man falls in love with a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside down after learning about his relationship with the woman from a previous birth.

title: Action
desc: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.

title: Teen Maar
desc: Michael's friend tries to convince him to pursue a long-distance relationship with Meera.

title: Kerintha
desc: College friends Jai, Sid, Bhavana, Nookaraju and Priya come from different family backgrounds. Each of them tries to find their passion and follow their dreams.

title: Ten
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to take Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

title: Balakrishnudu
desc: Trouble ensues when Balu, a money-hungry man, takes on the responsibility of protecting Aadhya from Pratap Reddy, who is feuding with her family.

title: Skanda: The Attacker
desc: After Rayudu and Ranjith Reddy's children elope, the CMs turn against each other. However, when a college student kidnaps Reddy's daughter, a revenge saga unravels.

title: Namo Venkatesa
desc: Ramana, a ventriloquist, falls in love with Pooja, the daughter of a rich factionist. However, when she is forced to marry against her wish, Ramana and her uncle decide to rescue her.

title: Amaran
desc: Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.

title: Kotha Lokah: Chapter 1 - Chandra
desc: A young woman with mystical abilities confronts personal struggles as evil emerges. However, to ensure the safety of the innocent, she must embrace her powers in an ever-changing world.
